sources.document_title: High Diode SMAJ series transient voltage suppressors
sources.locator: Page 1 features/polarity and page 2 exact SMAJ20A electrical row; pages 5-6 waveform/package
sources.evidence_extract: Official PDF states PPPM 400 W for a 10/1000 us pulse, -55 to 150 C, band marks cathode, and exact SMAJ20A: VBR 22.2-24.5 V at 1 mA, IR at most 5 uA at 20 V, VRWM 20 V, IPP 12.3 A, VC at most 32.4 V at IPP and TA 25 C. The API PD_mW field is not used for the 400 W claim. Ported into zudo-pd from the zudo-led-lamp bundle component-high-diode-smaj20a-c571370 at led-lamp commit e4e2dfd39811ccfba2bb36fb78b0b74a80c6eb1e; bytes/hash unchanged from that port.

Committed scripts/schgen/baselines/board-a.json (same commit and hash cited by component-stusb4500qtr's src-stusb-board-a-baseline and component-umw-ao3401a-c347476's src-ao3401a-board-a-baseline). D5.1 sits on VBUS_IN with J1.A9, J1.B9, U1.24, C1.2, C2.2, R14.1 and R11.2. D5.2 sits on GND with U1.6, U1.10, U1.12, U1.13, U1.22, U1.25, J1.7, J1.A12, J1.B12, C1.1, C2.1, C30.1, C34.2, C35.2, R17.2, R18.2, TP2.1, J2.3, J3.5, D6.2, D7.2, J4.5 and J4.6. This is the post-#93-fix topology: D5 (SMAJ20A) was newly added to replace the removed D4 (USBLC6-2SC6).
